name: Notes
description: Write and read notes, stored as text files in ~/notes.

changelog.1.1.0: Search your notes and edit them with the built-in editor; fixed the menu showing without its letters.
changelog.1.1.1: Now says what it can do (permissions: shown before you install, enforced while it runs), is listed in the new categories, and handles Ctrl+C and command-line arguments cleanly.
